prompts.prompt: In the NestJS request lifecycle, which runs first on an incoming request: guards or interceptors? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/nestjs/SKILL.md - Request Lifecycle: Middleware -> Guards -> Interceptors (before) -> Pipes -> Route Handler -> ...

prompts.prompt: Swapping NestJS's default Express HTTP adapter for the Fastify adapter typically yields roughly what percentage throughput improvement? Answer concisely.
When an unhandled exception occurs in a NestJS app, do exception filters run from route scope up to global scope, or from global scope down to route scope? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/nestjs/SKILL.md - Exception filters run in reverse scope order on error: Route -> Controller -> Global.
